summary: San Juan National Forest tower site in Archuleta County, Colorado; the register says the tower was taken down, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower has been taken down; the Colorado list marks it Removed; no removal date given

events.note: Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 18, 2009
Register page carries a photo dated May 1926

evidence.quote: This tower has been taken down.

evidence.supports: Administered by the U.S. Forest Service
Photo dated May 1926 on the register page
Registry number US 533, CO 5 on the register page
Colorado list: Tower, Removed, FFLOS US 533, CO 5
evidence.quote: Blue Mountain Archuleta 37.19556 -106.86056 Tower Removed FFLOS US 533, CO 5

evidence.supports: Colorado list gives slightly different coordinates

sources.title: Blue Mountain Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, a register entry and a state list. Neither gives a build year, a design, staffing or fire history, so the story leaves those out. Two WebSearch runs returned other Blue Mountain lookouts (NY, MT, WA, Victoria AU) and the Eightmile Mesa lookout in Archuleta County, which is a different site and was not used. Brief record checked: status, elevation, register number and coordinates agree with the register. The Colorado list coordinates differ from the register by a short distance; the story reports both.
